description.summary: Healing energy infuses and bathes your body in holy light.
description.value: Healing energy infuses and bathes your body in holy light. This spell cures 4d8 points of damage + 2 points per caster level (maximum +20) and ends any and all of the following adverse conditions affecting you: ability damage, blinded, confused, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, poisoned, and sickened. In addition, holy light functions as dispel upon a single additional effect of your choice that is affecting you and that can be legally affected by this effect.
